daily-trend-charts.reason: The check-in trend (daily, five 1-5 metrics: dashboard, check-in page, patient detail, 30-day population trend) and the assessment score trend (first shown at two results, often weeks apart) regularly span less than a month. ChartKit 0.6.0's LineChart labels its time axis only at month and year starts: timeTicks for 2026-10-01..2026-10-27 returns no tick, so these charts would show no date on the x axis (dates only on hover and in the hidden table). Migrate when LineChart labels days on spans under two months.

checkin-dot-strip.reason: The patients table's 7-day 'sparkline' is a strip of one dot per day, coloured by the day's wellness level (low, mid, high) and empty on a day with no check-in. ChartKit 0.6.0's Sparkline draws a line through the points it is given: it has no per-point tone and no slot for a missing day, so the level colours would be lost and a skipped day would be bridged as if it were recorded.

score-and-adherence-meters.reason: The per-dimension score bars (0-100) and the reports adherence bars (days checked in of 7) are coloured by threshold (teal, warn, danger) and sit next to a figure the layout already prints. ChartKit 0.6.0's Meter takes only value, max, label and href: it has no tone or colour input and always prints its own number beside the track, so it would drop the threshold colour and repeat the figure.
